review_description: The best thing about Sunny Sky Solar is that they're still around.I have occasionally called them about firmware updates to the inverter and they've always had my details available, and _quickly_.I asked for quoted from a number of providers before I chose Sunny Sky, they were the only ones who turned up at my door and actually had a look at where the panels could be mounted, didn't just use maps or satellites to assess. They weren't the cheapest, but they were the ones that were able to talk to me about the system, longevity, ROI, without just pushing for a signing date.The system has been working and operational since 2017.https://pvoutput.org/aggregate.jsp?id=61637&sid=54855&v=1&t=yThe Fronius inverter has worked well, so long as firmware updates are applied regularly.The Jinko panels have been great. No evidence of hot cells nor malfunctions when i had them cleaned and checked recently. (a process i recommend too)I'd like to expand or add to my system in future and would have no hesitation in having them do the installation.

Excellent installation and everything done with perfection. Explained everything about the system and requirements and everything was organized so quickly. Definitely recommend this company. From the very beginning there was no pushy antics and genuine advice, I did my research prior and they even recommended Fronius Gen24 with Trina S+ panels. Couldn't be happier and hope these guys get more feedback too.
Sunny sky solar were fabulous the sales right through to the tradies install. Recommend them to anyone
